material.description: Census: browser eval of performance resource entries with responseStatus >= 400 on https://lanmower.github.io/oscraft/js/client/play.html#moba (dispatch 1792914070940-5280-ea6ebede3dc9f719, session verify-404-census-1) lists exactly 15 requests, all 404, all scenarios/moba/assets/icons/heroes/<hero>-skinned.png for: mirana, puck, nevermore, razor, pudge, sven, tiny, zuus, kunkka, lina, slardar, viper, luna, leshrac, furion. The icons directory holds 110 skinned hero PNGs and none of these 15 under any name. Where the 404 is requested: scenarios/moba/panels.lua:103 and :119 (hero_icon), js/client/play.js:2794, scenarios/moba/assets/assets.json:7177 (the icon entries for these heroes), scenarios/moba/assets/doodads.json:1013, scripts/npc or gen-heroes.mjs:194 (the generated name map), units_heroes.osd:26. The 6.88g rows for these heroes are present; only the icon file is missing. Fix in this row: (1) the client must not request an icon that is not on disk, so the lobby draws a text tile (hero name) for a hero whose icon is missing, with no 404; (2) keep the icon path in data only where the file exists, or mark the missing ones in assets.json so the list matches the disk; (3) do not download a pack and do not generate icons here. Acceptance: the census re-run on the live page after the change shows zero 404 for hero icons; CI green on the pushed sha. The 15 real icons are a user input and stay listed in the row body.

references.why: alt text stands in for an image that is not loaded; a missing hero icon is drawn as its name instead of a request that 404s
